svg.text: What oewatch diff sees: one bad day, endpoint by endpoint
z-ai/glm-5.3-flash · Oct 7 → Oct 8 · endpoints whose quantization matches the production profile (fp8)
The other 22 listed endpoints are never eligible for this profile (fp4, nvfp4, unknown).
